result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations with differential operators in r (powers of ∂_r with coefficients a, b, c) acting on a function, comparing coefficients to derive conditions such as relations between ∂a/∂r, ∂b/∂r and ∂a/∂t, apparently in connection with transforming the heat-conduction equation.

methods.what: Commutator of two differential operators in r computed by coefficient comparison
Chain rule for change of variables in partial derivatives
methods.quote: $\frac{\partial u}{\partial t} = \frac{du}{dt} + \frac{\partial u}{\partial x}\frac{\partial x}{\partial t}$

methods.what: Condition from the highest-order term relating coefficients
Conditions on coefficients a, b, c for the fourth-order operator to commute with second-order operator

methods.what: Integrated form of the coefficient condition
